Subject: Next steps + pick a 30-min intro (two attendee options)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about Novarise's ingestion pipeline and the latency/cost constraints you mentioned. Per our discovery, it sounds like a 30-minute intro demo + brief infra Q&A will be the right next step to show a focused flow for your use case.

Could you please pick one of the windows below (all Pacific):

- Option A: Tue May 4, 10:00–10:30 AM PT (recommended: product + infra)
- Option B: Wed May 5, 2:00–2:30 PM PT (good for US east stakeholders)
- Option C: Thu May 6, 11:30–12:00 PM PT (short window for execs)

Also, can you confirm which Novarise attendees we should invite? From our side I’ll bring:
- Marissa Cole (Account Executive)
- Jonas Weber (Solutions Engineer)

I attached a draft mutual action plan and a short 30-min agenda so you can see what we intend to cover. If none of those times work, tell us two windows that do and we’ll adapt.

Next steps / ask: pick a slot and confirm 1–2 internal SMEs (engineering/security).

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: demo-brief-agenda-30min.md (text)]

Monica —

Appreciate the summary and the MAP. Quick answers: Option B (Wed May 5, 2:00–2:30 PM PT) looks best for us. Priya will be on the call; I’ll invite our infra lead, Samir (samir.khan@novarise.com), to cover deployment questions.

Two small asks before we lock:
1) Can Jonas touch on quantization/latency tradeoffs? That’s our primary technical concern.
2) We’re in the middle of a procurement sprint — would it be possible to include a very high-level pricing/consumption sketch so we can preview TCO?

Thanks — Alex

Thanks Alex — great, Wed 5/5 2:00–2:30 PM PT booked. I’ve sent a calendar invite to the people on this thread.

Quick responses to your asks:
- Jonas will cover quantization approaches and real-world latency numbers for a 1–3k RPS ingestion pattern; he can prepare a 5-min slide and a short demo snippet.
- I’ll include a concise consumption sketch in the invite packet — high-level units, example configs (hosted vs dedicated), and a ballpark monthly range so procurement has something to reference. This will not be a formal quote.

Attached: updated MAP with the booked slot and a slim agenda.

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5 min — What success looks like / priority flows (Alex)
2) 10 min — Product walkthrough (Marissa + demo)
3) 10 min — Technical Q&A (Jonas + Samir)
4) 5 min — Next steps / mutual action items

Can you confirm Samir’s email is samir.khan@novarise.com so I can add him to the invite?

Best,
Monica
